role: NestJS global module exporting the PrismaService for database access
detail: Defines a NestJS @Global() @Module() that provides and exports PrismaService. This is a minimal barrel that makes PrismaService available application-wide without explicit imports in consuming modules. The PrismaService is imported from ./prisma.service and registered as a provider. Global scope ensures all modules can access the database instance without re-declaring the dependency.
